xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5662: Composer: @ files and $ skills pickers, plus 'Ask anything. @ files, $ skills, / commands' placeholder

plan.title: Composer: @ files and $ skills pickers, plus 'Ask anything. @ files, $ skills, / commands' placeholder
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The conversation composer has only the / trigger. Typing @ or $ does nothing and the placeholder reads 'Message the agent…', so file references and skills are not discoverable from the conversation tab.
narratives.Proposal: Generalize the existing slash menu into one shared trigger menu (TriggerMenu.tsx, composerTriggers.ts pure helpers, one keyboard hook). Add an @ File menu that searches the conversation's explorer root through the existing pan.explorerSearchFiles RPC (root taken from useConversationChangesContext) and inserts '@<root-relative path> ' at the caret. Add a $ Skill menu over the same GET /api/skills/overrides list, gated and formatted by a new harness capability skillMention ('slash' for Claude Code inserts '/<name> ', 'dollar' for Codex inserts '$<name> ', null elsewhere). @ and $ detection is caret-aware and opens from text changes; / keeps its keydown path but opens only at a word start. The default placeholder becomes 'Ask anything. @ files, $ skills, / commands', listing only supported triggers. Full detail and decisions D1-D13 in .pan/drafts/PAN-5662.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server change: no new route, RPC method or file lister (reuse pan.explorerSearchFiles).
- No @ paths relative to a cwd that is a subfolder of the explorer root; inserted paths are root-relative.
- No quoting or escaping of file paths that contain whitespace.
- No @ or $ menus in the Home composer, the subagent composer, or a conversation mounted outside a Stage (popout/drawer).
- No change to which skills are listed (same GET /api/skills/overrides result and intercepted-name filter as PAN-5347); no skill pack skills.
- No structured skill input for Codex app-server; Codex receives the text '$<name> '.
- No folder rows in the @ menu; files only.
- No change to the / menu's contents, grouping, ranking or Tab-closes behavior beyond the word-start rule.
- No harness-name comparisons (harness === '<name>') in new code.

autoDecisions.summary: D1: add capability skillMention: 'slash' | 'dollar' | null and keep skillSlashCommands unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: skillSlashCommands still gates the / menu Skills group, so the four existing 'Codex fetches nothing' tests stay valid unedited; a contract test asserts skillSlashCommands === (skillMention === 'slash') so they never diverge.

autoDecisions.summary: D2: / opens its menu only at a word start (prompt start or after whitespace).
autoDecisions.rationale: Without it, typing a path inside an @ token (@src/comp) pops the slash menu; every existing / test types / at position 0, and a mid-word / (src/, and/or) is never a command.

autoDecisions.summary: D3: @ and $ detection and insertion are caret-aware inside the caret's Lexical text node (spliceText); / keeps whole-text context and root-rebuild insertion.
autoDecisions.rationale: @/$ tokens contain no whitespace so they always lie in one text node; splicing keeps text after the caret and line breaks, while / behavior stays byte-identical.

autoDecisions.summary: D4: @/$ menus open from text changes (open while a context exists and was not dismissed), not from keydown.
autoDecisions.rationale: AltGr layouts deliver @ with Ctrl+Alt set, which the existing / keydown filter rejects; change-driven opening is layout-independent.

autoDecisions.summary: D5: a live @/$ context hides the / menu and disables its key handler.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only one menu may own the keyboard; the caret is inside the @/$ token, so that menu is the relevant one.

autoDecisions.summary: D6: a $ context is valid only while its filter is empty or matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9._:-]*$/; skill rows match the name only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reconciles requirement 5 ($ after whitespace is a trigger) with the AC that 'echo $HOME' shows no menu: the menu opens on '$' and closes on the uppercase 'H'; '$5' never qualifies.

autoDecisions.summary: D7: Tab selects in @ and $ menus; Tab still closes the / menu.
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 1 asks for Tab select and requirement 3 keeps / unchanged; the shared key hook takes a tabSelects flag.

autoDecisions.summary: D8: ComposerFooter passes fileRootId from useConversationChangesContext()?.rootId; outside a Stage there is no @ menu.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the root the conversation panel already computes, adds no request, needs no QueryClientProvider in ComposerFooter tests, and respects PlainChangesScope's no-request design.

autoDecisions.summary: D9: insert root-relative paths from explorerSearchFiles.
autoDecisions.rationale: For project and issue roots this is the repo-relative path the issue asks for; cwd-relative paths are a NonGoal.

autoDecisions.summary: D10/D11: empty @ filter shows a non-selectable 'Type to search files' hint; searches request limit 20; Enter submits normally when no rows are shown.
autoDecisions.rationale: The server returns nothing for an empty query; Enter-only-with-rows matches the existing / menu rule.

autoDecisions.summary: D12/D13: placeholder is composed from fileRootId, skill context + skillMention, and slashCommandsEnabled (never the fetched list); an explicit placeholder prop wins; skill rows are labelled with the exact inserted form.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps fetch-only-while-open (PAN-5347 NFR) and lets SubagentComposer keep its own text; the label shows the operator what will be inserted.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex $<name> live delivery is an implementation checkpoint with a fixed fallback (keep inserting $<name>, file a follow-up for structured skill input).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue mandates $<name> for Codex and it is Codex's documented mention syntax, but delivery over codex app-server has not been observed in this codebase.

metadata.sizeJustification: 15 files across one subsystem (dashboard composer) plus the contracts capability and docs; the @ and $ menus share one menu, one key handler and one caret plumbing, so splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the shared-menu refactor.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4.
